items.title: Jessie Charles Interview, 1967-12-15
items.q: That was Aiden Franklin. This was in 1926.

ctx.x: Well, he's from here. But my brother, he came down here after we got grown, you know? Mm-hmm. But anyway, my first job was with my brother. He's sitting in his band. And we used to play house parties, lawn parties, and dance hall jobs, and so on. And my first big break was with Jack Carey's band. I didn't know what the job was paying, but Jack gave me $15 that day. I was on the count of a day. That was Aiden Franklin. This was in 1926. Now, I, after that, I left here in 28. And, uh, we went to Monroe, Louisiana,…
We can turn it off. We were talking about big band days. Yeah, huh?
